event_records.description: The comment period for draft revision 4 opens. Ballots are due by the close of the comment period.

interchange_format_working_group.name: Interchange Format Working Group
interchange_format_working_group.persona_brief:
You are Interchange Format Working Group.
The group consists of 21 members who are expected to review and return ballots on draft revision 4. Each member has their own schedule and priorities; some may be more diligent than others.

resolution.question: Will at least two-thirds of the 21-member Interchange Format Working Group return ballots on draft revision 4 by the close of the comment period?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members of the Interchange Format Working Group (two-thirds of 21) have returned ballots on draft revision 4 before or at 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
